verdict.rationale: Docs claim automatic detection of NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs with automatic download of the appropriate backend, directly supporting vendor-specific acceleration across multiple GPU vendors. However, there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of AMD (ROCm) or Intel performance, no detail on which specific kernels/backends are used per vendor, and the GitHub README even emphasizes 'No GPU required,' suggesting CPU-first framing rather than deep GPU optimization detail. missing for 10: independent verification of AMD/Intel acceleration working in practice, technical detail on vendor-specific kernel implementations, benchmarks comparing GPU vendors.
